HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: The 1/6 protocol fee share from SushiSwap Classic swaps.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: The 5/6 fee share retained by liquidity providers.

HoldersRevenue.Buy Back And Burn CAKE: 0.0575% is used to facilitate CAKE buyback and burn.

Fees.Mint/Redeem Fees: Fees emitted by V1 Collateralized and Redeemed events.

Revenue.Mint/Redeem Fees To Treasury: V1 mint and redeem fees collected by the protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Mint/Redeem Fees To Treasury: V1 mint and redeem fees collected by the protocol treasury.

Volume.Mint Volume: Gross V1 collateral deposited for minting volatility token pairs.
Volume.Redeem Volume: Gross V1 collateral redeemed by burning volatility token pairs.

Fees.Vault Fees: Fees paid in ETH to mint, redeem or swap NFTs in an NFTX vault, plus 10% of premium fees.
Fees.NFT Premium Fees: The 90% of premium fees passed to the NFT's depositor. A premium starts at 5x one vToken and decays to zero over the 10 hours after an NFT is deposited.
Fees.AMM Swap Fees: Swap fees on the NFTX AMM's vToken/WETH pools (0.3% or 1% fee tiers).

Revenue.Vault Fees To Treasury: Vault fees sent to the NFTX treasury when the vault had no LPs or inventory stakers to receive them.

ProtocolRevenue.Vault Fees To Treasury: Vault fees sent to the NFTX treasury when the vault had no LPs or inventory stakers to receive them.

SupplySideRevenue.Vault Fees To Liquidity Providers: 80% of vault fees, paid to LPs of the vToken's 0.3% pool.
SupplySideRevenue.Vault Fees To Inventory Stakers: 20% of vault fees, paid to inventory stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.NFT Premium Fees To Depositors: 90% of premium fees, paid to the address that deposited the redeemed NFT.
SupplySideRevenue.AMM Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: All NFTX AMM swap fees, paid to the pool's LPs (the AMM protocol fee is off).

Fees.Sportsbook Gross Gaming Revenue: From 2026-07-21: buy-in minus final payout (winnings, cash-out or refund) of every sportsbook ticket settled in the period, excluding free bet tickets.
Fees.Sportsbook Trading Fees: Before 2026-07-21: SafeBox fee charged on sportsbook ticket buy-ins, including the share paid to referrers.
Fees.Sportsbook LP Performance Fees: Before 2026-07-21: share of each profitable weekly liquidity pool round sent to the SafeBox.
Fees.Casino Gross Gaming Revenue: Stakes minus payouts of casino bets (Roulette, Dice, Blackjack, Baccarat, Slots and the CasinoCoreV2 games: Plinko, Hi-Lo, Keno, Video Poker, Three Card Poker, Ultimate and Bonus Hold'em, Penalty Shootout), excluding free bets.
Fees.Speed Markets Gross Gaming Revenue: Buy-in plus SafeBox and LP fees minus payout of every Speed Markets and Chained Speed Markets position resolved in the period, excluding free bets.
Fees.Free Bet Winnings: Net winnings paid to users on protocol-funded free bets (negative).

Revenue.Sportsbook Gross Gaming Revenue To Proto: From 2026-07-21: sportsbook result kept by the protocol, the treasury being the only liquidity provider, net of referral fees.
Revenue.Sportsbook Trading Fees To SafeBox: Before 2026-07-21: SafeBox fee on sportsbook buy-ins, net of the referral share.
Revenue.Sportsbook LP Performance Fees To SafeBo: Before 2026-07-21: SafeBox share of profitable liquidity pool rounds.
Revenue.Casino Gross Gaming Revenue To Protocol: Casino result kept by the treasury-funded bankrolls, net of referral fees.
Revenue.Speed Markets Gross Gaming Revenue To Pr: Speed Markets result kept by the treasury-funded AMMs. Referral fees paid out of the SafeBox fee on referred positions are not tracked and are not deducted.
Revenue.Free Bet Winnings Paid By Protocol: Net winnings paid to users on protocol-funded free bets (negative).

SupplySideRevenue.Sportsbook Referral Fees To Referrers: Share of the sportsbook SafeBox fee paid to the referrer of the bettor.
SupplySideRevenue.Casino Referral Fees To Referrers: Share of lost casino stakes paid to the referrer of the player.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Stablecoins (USDC, sUSD before December 2024) spent by the SafeBoxBuyback contracts to buy back and burn OVER (THALES before the migration).

ProtocolRevenue.Sportsbook Gross Gaming Revenue To Proto: From 2026-07-21: sportsbook result kept by the protocol, net of referral fees.
ProtocolRevenue.Sportsbook Trading Fees To SafeBox: Before 2026-07-21: SafeBox fee on sportsbook buy-ins, net of the referral share.
ProtocolRevenue.Sportsbook LP Performance Fees To SafeBo: Before 2026-07-21: SafeBox share of profitable liquidity pool rounds.
ProtocolRevenue.Casino Gross Gaming Revenue To Protocol: Casino result kept by the treasury-funded bankrolls, net of referral fees.
ProtocolRevenue.Speed Markets Gross Gaming Revenue To Pr: Speed Markets result kept by the treasury-funded AMMs, not net of referral fees (not tracked).
ProtocolRevenue.Free Bet Winnings Paid By Protocol: Net winnings paid to users on protocol-funded free bets (negative).
ProtocolRevenue.Token Buy Back: Stablecoins spent on OVER buybacks, moved to holders revenue (negative).

Fees.Aquila V2: 30 bps × swap notional on every Aquila pair.
Fees.Gladius: All taker fees collected by the Rubicon fee wallet.

Revenue.Aquila V2: ~5 bps (1/6 of LP fee) on OP/Arb/Base; 0 on mainnet.
Revenue.CLMM V3: Live per-pool pool.slot0().feeProtocol cut, read per timeslot (currently 1/6 where the fee switch is on).
Revenue.Gladius: All taker fees collected by the Rubicon fee wallet.

ProtocolRevenue.Aquila V2: ~5 bps (1/6 of LP fee) on OP/Arb/Base; 0 on mainnet.
ProtocolRevenue.CLMM V3: Live per-pool pool.slot0().feeProtocol cut, read per timeslot (currently 1/6 where the fee switch is on).
ProtocolRevenue.Gladius: All taker fees collected by the Rubicon fee wallet.

SupplySideRevenue.Aquila V2: ~25 bps on OP/Arb/Base; 30 bps on mainnet (fee switch off).
SupplySideRevenue.CLMM V3: Whatever's left after the live per-pool pool.slot0().feeProtocol cut.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from the fee legs every Swap event carries.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: The creator leg, claimable only to the market's immutable creator. Launch presets: 0.70% of each trade on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets, 0.10% on factory 0.11.0 markets; actual amounts are read from each Swap event.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Curve Reserves: The depth leg, which stays in the market's curve reserve and raises its price floor.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Token Buyback And Burn: The buyback leg, spent only on buying and burning the market's own token.
